Real-time sub mm Part tracking with CAD alignment – AI detections and 3D calculations are used to eliminate the need for dedicated Jigs or space. AI models - Patented accelerated Pre-trained large AI models, ready from day 1 with no need for part-specific AI training Accurate Dimensional measurements and Quality inspection – all in one solution Pre-trained, high-performance Large AI models – Trained on over 35,000 real-world manufacturing variations and enriched with millions of augmentations Plug-and-play with PLM Systems EASILY DEPLOYED AND MAINTAINED USING STANDARD PRODUCTION FLOOR EQUIPMENT – PCS AND STANDARD CAMERAS SkillReal Technology 01 physical AI Physical AI works with matter. It senses the real world, reasons about what it finds, and acts on it, on a production line, in real time, while the part is still moving. SkillReal is the perception layer: the first in-line 3D AI platform that aligns every part to its digital twin and verifies it to sub-millimeter accuracy, inside the cycle, on 100% of production. Physical AI needs ground truth. Verifies presence, location and quality, with >99.7% reliability 04 Open Platform and Advanced Analytics Advanced analytics , AI and custom dashboards provide role-specific insights, and full digital traceability. Integrates with PLC, HMI and other factory systems to deliver real-time data for immediate corrective actions and quality improvement. jobs.title: Industries
jobs.description: Industries: 3D AI Inspection Use Cases | SkillReal Skip to content Products In-Line Technology Industries Partners Company About Us News & events Careers Resources library Magazine Contact Us Sign In Enhancing Productivity and Quality Across Industries Automotive The automotive industry is changing and companies are highly focused on process improvement and cost reduction. SkillReal is particularly useful in this environment by addressing the most urgent automotive manufacturing needs. This is accomplished by closing the gap between the digital and physical twins and by enabling effective alignment of robot programs and inspection of manufactured parts during the pre-serial and serial manufacturing, while delivering significant savings in time, reworks, manpower and material costs. Heavy Industry In the heavy industry sector—such as construction, agriculture, and industrial equipment manufacturing—production often involves complex assemblies and a high degree of manual operations, including welding, which are prone to variability and human error. Ensuring structural integrity and quality across large-scale components is critical, yet challenging. SkillReal brings value by enhancing process control and visibility through the alignment of digital and physical workflows. By enabling accurate inspection and validation of welded structures and assemblies in real time, SkillReal helps reduce costly rework, minimize downtime, and improve first-time quality, even in environments with significant manual labor. Data Centers & Logistics Infrastructure Demand for data center and logistics infrastructure is accelerating, putting growing pressure on manufacturers to deliver large structural elements, frames, and welded assemblies faster, without compromising dimensional accuracy or quality. SkillReal bridges the gap between digital design and physical production directly on the line, enabling real-time inspection of holes, welds, fasteners, and critical dimensions as parts are manufactured. By integrating into both existing and new production lines without dedicated inspection cells, SkillReal allows manufacturers to scale output without inspection becoming a bottleneck. This capability has already been proven on structural elements supplied to one of the world’s largest data center and logistics operators. SkillReal is a leading startup specializing in advanced AI, computer vision, and digital twin technology for accurate 3D inspection and alignment in automotive manufacturing. Our software platform helps manufacturers inspect complex parts and assemblies faster, reduce manual inspection effort, and improve quality through highly accurate, real-time measurement and reporting. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working hands-on with technology, solving real manufacturing problems, and becoming an expert user of an advanced inspection platform. The Application Engineer will support customer demonstrations, deployments, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and feedback to the product development team. About You We are looking for a self-starter who is excited about new technology, manufacturing, and solving challenging problems in the field. You’ll thrive on our team if you are: Highly motivated, dependable, and willing to work hard in a startup environment. A strong critical thinker who can work through technical problems independently. Comfortable learning complex software tools and becoming a true product expert. Excited by AI, computer vision, digital twins, automation, and automotive manufacturing. Hands-on and practical, with the ability to work in both an office and plant-floor environment. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to document your work clearly. Collaborative, communicative, and comfortable working with customers, engineers, and internal teams. Flexible and adaptable as priorities evolve in a fast-moving company. Responsibilities and Duties Become an expert user of the SkillReal digital twin inspection platform. Support pre-sales and post-sales activities, including customer demonstrations, technical discussions, production deployments. Assist with customer implementations at automotive manufacturing sites. Review customer requirements, CAD models, feature maps, weld files, tolerances, and inspection needs. Prepare and maintain software configuration files, operations files, and customer-specific inspection setups. Support system setup, calibration, alignment, verification runs, data collection, and customer acceptance testing. Design and execute tests to validate repeatability, accuracy, performance, and system readiness. Create documentation including user guides, deployment checklists, troubleshooting procedures, testing protocols, and customer-facing summaries. Prepare concise presentations and reports to communicate findings, status, risks, and recommendations. Support hardware selection and deployment planning, including cameras, lenses, lighting, cables, computers, GPUs, mounts, and related equipment. Help build repeatable processes for future deployments so SkillReal can scale efficiently across customers and applications. Provide customer training and technical support during and after deployment. Represent SkillReal professionally with customers, partners, integrators, and manufacturing teams. Strong attention to detail and ability to document technical work clearly. Willingness to travel frequently to customer sites across the United States. Preferred Qualifications Experience in automotive manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, quality engineering, metrology, inspection, automation, machine vision, or robotics. Basic knowledge of Python, scripting, databases, or software configuration. Experience with cameras, optics, lighting, 3D inspection, measurement systems, or vision-based inspection equipment.
